{{< include /_chapters/gmm.ASC.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(GMPETable) && nrow(GMPETable[TRT == "ASC"])) {
  Mw.target <- if (!exists("Mw.gmm", inherits = FALSE)) 6.5 else if (is.null(names(Mw.gmm))) Mw.gmm[[1L]] else if ("ASC" %in% names(Mw.gmm)) Mw.gmm[["ASC"]] else 6.5
  NGR::knitBlock(path = "/_fig/GMPE.qmd", stem = "a1-asc-att", labels = "rewrite", vars = list(ID.target = unique(GMPETable[TRT == "ASC", ID]), Mw.target = Mw.target), root = root)
  NGR::knitBlock(path = "/_fig/GMPE.PSA.qmd", stem = "a1-asc-psa", labels = "rewrite", vars = list(ID.target = unique(GMPETable[TRT == "ASC", ID]), Mw.target = Mw.target, Repi.target = 100), root = root)
  rm(Mw.target)
}
```
